svg.title: MVCC
svg.desc: A statement job opens a repeatable read transaction and reads account 7: balance 100, version 1. The payment service writes 60 as a new version 2 without waiting, and when both read again the job still sees 100 while the payment service sees 60. Dead versions pile up while the job's snapshot is open, and once it commits, VACUUM frees version 1 and the rest.
svg.text: Reads and writes never wait. Old versions stay until VACUUM clears them.
